reviewer: Primary agent; personal image inspection, no delegated review
scope: All point close/wide stages and corrected crosshairs, 11 sixteen-control regions, 3 extended-reference southern regions, 11 final seventeen-control regions, 4 seams per experiment and 3 browser screenshots per experiment. All 63 hashed figures in packet-verification.json were personally viewed.
point_review: Native source remained unrotated. Identity review and pixel corrections preceded first score for each point. Guide projections were search aids only.

final_regions.northwest-rivers: Local Musk Rat and upper Sam alignment improves; western network still displaced.
final_regions.baddeck-forks: Local fitted confluences close; upstream branches and braided reaches diverge.
final_regions.christopher-big-glen: Some broad bends and upper reaches are more displaced than on fourteen controls; local C02 remains close.
final_regions.st-anns-monroe: Controlled coast closer; interior ponds and tributaries displaced.
final_regions.seal-otter: Near-island controls close; island shape and coast tributaries disagree.
final_regions.baddeck-kidston: Local shore/island correspondence; interior and delta divergence. Stony Island modern counterpart not established.
final_regions.port-bevis: Broad harbour and Bevis lobes remain displaced; no fabricated coastal identity.
final_regions.island-point: Control near outer point; west shore and interior diverge.
final_regions.kemp-coffin-extension: Full extension retained. Fraser/Coffin shapes and neck/island difference unresolved.
final_regions.lockman-extension: Full extension retained. Hook control close; remaining coastline/interior displaced.
final_regions.full-sheet: Complete mapped frame and three southern extensions retained; no visible internal holes.

seams.13-west-north: Both provisional maps show displaced stream reaches along the boundary; no accepted continuous join.
seams.13-west-south: Stream and lower channel placement differ; common mapped strip does not establish alignment.
seams.10-north-west: Gap between mapped coverage in this geographic window; upper river branches disagree.
seams.10-north-east: Mapped frames approach at St Anns but coast/reaches and other northern gaps remain unresolved.

browser: Final actual TIFF import, desktop reload and mobile 390x844 reload show complete rendered map; recorded source bytes, alpha and enabled state persist. Sixteen-control mobile evidence was viewport change after desktop reload, not a separate mobile reload. No native PNG plus CSV mesh acceptance claim.
